messages:
Sylvia: heads up — I'm seeing a cluster of /v1/chat requests that the gateway routed to fallback-rate-limited (priority=10) instead of canary-route (priority=100). The requests include header x-env: canary.
Liam: did the LB rewrite headers? any decision-log entries?
Jonah: decision log shows match=false for canary-route with reason "header_mismatch". but tcp capture has "x-env: canary".
Maya: paste the decision-log snippet and which sampling cohort? we need traces.
Sylvia: here's truncated decision-log from s3:

```
{ "route_id": "canary-route", "rule": {"type":"header_eq","key":"x-env","value":"canary"}, "result": false, "reason": "header_mismatch", "sampled": false }
```

Sylvia: note sampled:false — we're blind for many of these because sampling is only seeded after a match.
Liam: router runtime normalizes header keys to lowercase (2.3.1). Console stored the rule with mixed-case key "X-Env" in some migrations.
Jonah: ah—console persisted header rules case-preserved. runtime does headers.get("x-env") so if rule uses "X-Env" it misses.
Maya: repro locally:
```
ROUTER_RULES=./test/canary.json make dev-run-router
curl -H "X-Env: canary" -H "Authorization: Bearer ..." http://localhost:8080/v1/chat
# response: matched fallback-route
DEBUG: matched headers: {"x-env":"canary"}
```
Maya: console rule persisted as "X-Env" so evaluation checked the literal key.
Liam: two correlated issues: (1) case-mismatch between console and runtime, (2) sampling happens post-match so we don't get traces when match unexpectedly fails.
Sylvia: proposed fixes: (A) normalize header keys when persisting/reading rules from console DB; (B) make runtime match header keys case-insensitively; (C) add a pre-eval sampling hook so mismatches can be traced.
Maya: low-risk mitigation: normalize stored keys on read in route-eval service and ship a small patch. I'll update the runbook to include this as an immediate mitigation.
Liam: I'll open a small PR in eng-platform/route-eval that lowercases header keys on rule load. Tests: unit tests for normalization + integration against dev router.
Jonah: telemetry follow-up: add metric route_eval.mismatch.header_case counted per-route and per-environment; also add a trace attribute "header_case_mismatch" so we can link traces when present.
Sylvia: add a debug trace toggled by config (router.debug.sample_on_mismatch) that forces sampled:true for 1:1000 mismatches so we can capture root cause without raising global sampling.
Liam: I can add that toggle. Will default false; will be gated behind console feature flag for initial rollout.
Maya: dashboard tasks: add tile showing route_eval.mismatch.header_case / route_eval.requests (14d baseline) and an alert if ratio > 0.1% for 1h.
Jonah: short-term extraction: run `aws s3 cp s3://redwood-decision-logs/epoch/$(date -d "1 hour ago" +%s) - | jq 'select(.route_id=="fallback-rate-limited")' | grep -C3 header_mismatch` to pull recent matches.
Sylvia: plan: Liam PR today -> staging canary -> metric/trace ticket (Jonah) -> runbook + dashboard (Maya). I'll monitor and post updates.
infra-bot: deploy bot — canary patch liam/normalize-header-keys pushed to staging at 2025-11-09T15:42:02Z
Liam: staging tests green; starting canary deploy to prod.
Maya: saw drop in mismatch metric on staging after patch. will promote when canary window passes.
Sylvia: follow-ups assigned: console migration to persist normalized keys; telemetry pre-eval sampling prototype; runbook note. tagging @eng-sre for rollout coordination. :thumbsup:
